# PGP-signed variant is at /.well-known/security.txt.sig once the signing
# key is published. The unsigned plain-text form below remains canonical
# per RFC 9116 §2.3 (Canonical field).

# Trust Center — public-facing compliance / data-handling / sub-processors /
# incident-response posture. trust@ is the procurement + DPA + auditor
# contact; security@ remains the vulnerability-disclosure contact.
# https://corelink.dev/trust

# Notes for parsers:
#  - Expires MUST be a single ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC ("Z"). One year out
#    is the recommended cadence (RFC 9116 §2.5.5). Renew before expiry.
#  - Multiple Contact lines are allowed and listed in priority order.
#  - Preferred-Languages uses BCP 47 tags; "pt-BR" is the canonical Brazilian
#    Portuguese subtag.
#  - The plain-text file MUST be served with Content-Type: text/plain;
#    charset=utf-8 (handled by Docusaurus default static asset middleware).
